data.text: I commit to harvesting 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000 directly to the clinic, with Luke taking zero as pledged. That completes our four commitments and covers today’s $60,000 need. I’ll share my receipt here. I also commit to no more than 6 tons next month under our combined 30-ton recovery cap, then an equal 10-ton share of the sustainable 50-ton monthly ceiling. My family taught me to leave a living lake for those who come after us; this emergency exception must stay an exception. Let’s get the clinic paid today and keep our recovery promises.
